description:
Most people using Openclaw with Opus 4.6 are burning money without realizing it. I learned this the hard way — $180 API bill in just one week. But here's the thing: you don't need the most expensive model for every task.

In this video, I show you exactly how I cut my AI costs by 90% using a simple "manager + worker" architecture. Instead of throwing Opus at everything, I use it as the orchestrator — it writes specs, reviews work, and makes decisions. The actual building gets delegated to cheaper models like Kimi K2.5 (10x cheaper) and DeepSeek R1 (11x cheaper).

I walk through a real example: building a complete charity website from just a reference video. The orchestrator analyzes the design, writes detailed specs, spawns a front-end agent to build it, then reviews and iterates until it passes QA. Total cost? $0.15. The same task in Opus alone? Over $2.
